title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up of pressure ulcer.

HPI
Pt is a 73-year-old female presenting for follow up of a pressure ulcer on the right heel. Pt reports the area is intact but feels tender. No drainage noted since last visit. Pt reports compliance with offloading measures.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
Gen: Alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: Pressure ulcer noted on the right heel. Area appears stable. No purulent drainage or systemic signs of concern.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Pressure ulcer, right heel.

Plan
1. Continue current wound care regimen.
2. Maintain offloading of the right heel.
3. F/u in 2 weeks for re-evaluation of the pressure ulcer.

Electronically signed,
M. Okafor, PA-C
10/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the right heel, stage not documented: L89.619 (no HCC).

distractors.why: No stage is documented: use the unspecified-stage code.
